g.text: Lifespan of UM-HET3 males: maternal allele, B against C (rows: BXD T-ages × 1.23, the ratio of median ages at death)

text.style: font-size: 17.04px; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic; font-family: "Arial";

g.text: at one T-age: 3.4 to 3.6 over these rows. From 1,000 permutations of lifespans within site

Model: lm(age at death ~ site + cohort + treatment + maternal B dosage, P(BH) + P(BD)), likelihood-ratio test (1 d.f.), as in Danny Arends's ProgressiveMapping.R. UM-HET3 males alive at T; 891 markers (Arends et al. 2026, Supplementary Table 7).
Lifespan of UM-HET3 males: paternal allele, D against H (rows: BXD T-ages × 1.23, the ratio of median ages at death)

text.style: font-size: 17.04px; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic; font-family: "Arial";

g.text: at one T-age: 3.3 to 3.5 over these rows. From 1,000 permutations of lifespans within site

Model: lm(age at death ~ site + cohort + treatment + paternal D dosage, P(CD) + P(BD)), likelihood-ratio test (1 d.f.), as in Danny Arends's ProgressiveMapping.R. UM-HET3 males alive at T; 891 markers (Arends et al. 2026, Supplementary Table 7).
Mapping: umhet3_maps.R (robwwilliams/BxDLifeSpan). Paternal calls on proximal Chr 1 are biased toward H at UM and UT. A male has no paternal X so the paternal X is not mapped.
